message.content: In my view, **“Parasite”** stands out as the best film of 2020. Though it premiered in late 2019, its impact carried strongly into 2020—winning the Academy Award for Best Picture during the 92nd Oscars ceremony held that year—and it remains a landmark achievement in global cinema.
